title: Art. 15.1.2 — Procedures for Air Navigation Services - Air Traffic Management (Doc 4444), Chapter 15 - Procedures Related to Emergencies, Communication Failure and Contingencies, 15.1 Emergency Procedures, 15.1.2 Priority
content: An aircraft known or believed to be in a state of emergency, including being subjected to unlawful interference, shall be given priority over other aircraft.
